candidates.description: These tokens represent subword fragments and characters from Hindi text encoding and Devanagari script.
This vector activates on various isolated Devanagari characters and incomplete Hindi word fragments.
This vector activates strongly on common Hindi pronouns, demonstratives, and inflections within multilingual text.
This vector activates on common Devanagari script characters, linguistic suffixes, and file extensions.
This vector represents the Hindi suffix and character combination 'स' (sa) and its variations in various phonetic contexts.
This feature vector is related to Hindi script characters, vowel signs, and common Devanagari sub-word tokens.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments primarily from the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates on common Hindi vowel sign diacritics combined with punctuation marks.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel sign suffixes and character combinations often found in transliterated or native text processing.
This vector activates for common subwords, root elements, and characters in the Hindi language.
